Concealment examined; Lord spans rule and rulelessness.
Touching, he shines; self-willed, resorting to rule.
Three acts ordained intermediately; endless at the great scale.
One Lord drops rule, keeps form; unforced stasis.
Form kept, rule dropped; veiled by self-concealing rule.
Suffering enjoyed; then fruit-order; restraint dropped, delusion envelops.
Awakened sits as unawakened in disregardful concealment.
Uncrossed acts crossed, hating the fool-conduct.
Heart-fool is the awakened way; Mānastotra attests.
Sun-appointed lack dissent not; lotus-sun proof.
Learned strayers breed false dawn like lamplight.
Lead stays copper; undrunk nectar leaves thirst.
Awakened conduct burns with doubt within.
No karma explains concealment; no precedent binds.
Grace returns by self or another's door.
Even the concealed dead are graced.
Partless unfits departure; fasts don't either.
Don't eject the soul from longing.
Detached perfected may leave the body.
Freedom taught in all duties openly.
